description_en: Modifies the acceleration region of a domain name
description_zh: 修改直播域名加速区域
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-live-domain-schdm-by-property --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_global --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLiveDomainSchdmByProperty

parameters.help_en: The live streaming domain for which you want to modify the acceleration region
parameters.help_zh: 需修改加速区域的直播域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. A value of {"coverage":"overseas"} specifies that the configuration is for regions outside mainland China. The following list describes the valid values for coverage:

domestic: mainland China.

overseas: regions outside mainland China.

global: regions in and outside mainland China
parameters.help_zh:
修改加速区域。
{“coverage”:“overseas”} 指的是该配置面向的是海外区域。下面是对三个支持的coverage值的说明：
domestic：中国内地。
overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
global：全球加速
parameters.name: property
